cases.sentence: У Иакова замерло ___, и он не поверил им.
cases.explain: Сердце is the subject of the verb замерло, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Слух о том, что пришли братья Иосифа, дошел до двора ___.
cases.explain: Двор ___ (court of Pharaoh) is a possessive genitive construction.

cases.sentence: Расскажите же моему ___ о том, как я прославлен в Египте.
cases.explain: The verb расскажите (tell) takes its indirect object (to whom) in the dative case.
The transitive verb подарил (gave as a gift) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он поцеловал всех братьев и с ___ обнимал их.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Уже два года, как в ___ голод.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Тогда Иосиф не мог более сдерживать себя перед рабами и воскликнул.
reading.question: What happened when Joseph could no longer control his emotions in front of his servants?
options: He cried out for everyone to leave
He forgave his brothers publicly at once
reading.correct: He cried out for everyone to leave
reading.explain: Joseph could not control himself and cried out 'Уходите все прочь от меня!' — leave me, everyone!

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал братьям, «Я Иосиф, жив ли еще мой отец?»
reading.question: What was Joseph's first question to his brothers after revealing himself?
reading.explain: Joseph reveals himself and immediately asks whether his father is still alive.

reading.ru: Это Бог послал меня перед вами для спасения вашей жизни
reading.question: According to Joseph, who sent him to Egypt ahead of his brothers?
reading.explain: Joseph tells his brothers that God sent him ahead of them to save their lives.

reading.ru: Ты будешь жить в области Гошен и будешь рядом со мной
reading.question: Where did Joseph invite his father to come and live?
reading.explain: Joseph tells his father he will live in the region of Goshen, near him.

reading.ru: «Скажи братьям, сделайте вот что, навьючьте своих животных, возвращайтесь в землю Ханаана и приведите ко мне отца и ваши семьи.
reading.question: What did Pharaoh tell Joseph to instruct his brothers to do?
options: Load their animals and bring their father and families from Canaan
Stay in Canaan and send grain
reading.correct: Load their animals and bring their father and families from Canaan
reading.explain: Pharaoh instructs Joseph to have the brothers load their animals and bring their father and families to Egypt.

reading.ru: а Вениамину дал триста шекелей серебра и пять смен одежды.
reading.question: What extra gift did Joseph give specifically to Benjamin?
options: Three hundred shekels of silver and five changes of clothing
reading.correct: Three hundred shekels of silver and five changes of clothing
reading.explain: Joseph gave Benjamin three hundred shekels of silver and five changes of clothing.

reading.ru: У Иакова замерло сердце, и он не поверил им.
reading.question: How did Jacob react when told Joseph was alive?
options: His heart stood still and he didn't believe them
He wept for joy at once
reading.correct: His heart stood still and he didn't believe them
reading.explain: Jacob's heart stood still and he did not believe the news at first.

reading.ru: И Израиль сказал, «Довольно, мой сын Иосиф жив, пойду и увижу его, прежде чем умру».
reading.question: What did Israel (Jacob) decide to do once convinced Joseph was alive?
options: Go and see Joseph before he dies
reading.correct: Go and see Joseph before he dies
reading.explain: Israel says it is enough, and that he will go to see Joseph before he dies.
